new_findings_this_pass: go:'done' -> handleCompletedOutcome (task-scheduler.ts:233-277): (1) `completed` is NOT in RETRYABLE_STATES [failed,blocked,cancelled] -> the task can NEVER be resumed, so Path A's promised outcome is structurally impossible on Path B; (2) cleanupWorkspace(id,true) destroys the worktree; (3) posts ticket_comment 'Task completed successfully.' to the source ticket — the owner literally sees 'I cannot merge it' followed by 'completed successfully' on the same unmerged PR (criterion 10, concretely); (4) eagerly reaps and frees the idempotency key.

NOT data-destructive: workspace-reaper:312-321 sees merged_at === null, treats it as push-only and PRESERVES the branch — checked deliberately since a completed+unmerged task looked like it might get its branch deleted. The PR survives; the harm is the false 'completed', the destroyed worktree, and lost resumability.

go:'block' + awaiting_human -> need_more_info puts the task on the health-monitor blocked-escalation ladder (checkBlockedEscalation excludes only pr_review_pending): reminder@4h repeating, self_unblock@8h, escalation_alert@48h -> task -> `failed`. So blocked-resumable nudges the owner, tries once to self-unblock, then fails HONESTLY — criterion 10 satisfied by an existing mechanism. Loop-safety is identical to `done` (both leave the pr_review_pending poll set), so it is NOT a differentiator.

Self-unblock nuance for design: awaiting_human IS eligible for evaluate_self_unblock (only awaiting_human_decision is skipped, health-monitor.ts:250-256). If the agent ever answers can_resolve:true, the task re-dispatches, re-blocks, and last_transition_at resets — restarting the ladder, so the 48h escalation may never fire (a slow ~8h re-check cycle). Flagged with honest uncertainty: the answer is an LLM call I cannot verify from code.

A THIRD path nobody named: derivePrEvents (github-hosting.ts:504) emits pr_ready_to_merge only when merge_state === 'mergeable', and the poller's escalation requires an /approve COMMENT. So a formally-approved + green + host-blocked PR produces no event, no promotion, no escalation — it sits under pr_review_pending receiving misleading 'waiting for review' reminders. Reachable via require-conversation-resolution, merge restrictions, an unreported required check, or CODEOWNER review. Mild (no loop, no rework) — surfaced as a scope question for design, NOT expanded into scope on my own authority.
design_forks_surfaced_not_decided: Which single contract (criterion 9) — evidence is now lopsided toward blocked-resumable: `done` destroys the worktree, forbids retry, and says 'completed successfully'; `block` preserves it, is retryable, nudges, and fails honestly. Minimal change: add a needs_human_merge case to autoMergeNext returning { go:'block', category: awaiting_human, needed } — mirroring the already-tested needs_human branch at :75-80.

Distinguish the block reason vs. word one honest message (criterion 11) — distinguishing stays expensive (reviewDecision is GraphQL-only; mergeable_state 'blocked' is a catch-all), so wording that holds in both cases is the cheap route. Path A's unconditional 'I will merge it' must go.
awaiting_human vs awaiting_human_decision for the reconciled block (self-unblock eligibility / guaranteed escalation).
Whether to close the third path (section 24) — a scope question against the owner's criteria 9-13.
